featured_reviews.name: vijay ghogare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi Cover the world team,
Me & my wife just finished our tour to Sikkim. Thought of sharing a feedback on our experience.
First of all appreciate the support all through our first interaction since we weee exploring multiple options to visit till you advised us selecting the most exciting Sikkim option and actually concluded experiencing the same. You proactively provided all guidance and information exactly when we wanted, anticipating our needs rather than we keep chasing for the same. Entire team network really functioned as a single cohesive team although operating from different geographies and locations.

A special thanks to the local representative, Bijay Mishra, and our drivers Navdeep, Bhutia, and Nitesh. Their professionalism, discipline, and expertise in navigating challenging terrain gave us immense comfort. Beyond their skills, their warmth, respect, and personal care demonstrated the true spirit of “Atithi Devo Bhava.”
We were especially touched by Bhutia’s prompt help when I had a minor injury—his first aid support and guidance to the hospital reflected both humanity and professionalism.

All hotel stays, locations, facilities, and food exceeded our expectations.
We are also extremely grateful to Anuja Ma’am for her constant, round-the-clock assistance. Her proactive guidance made us feel as though she was always right there with us throughout the journey.

Our sincere thanks to Nihira Ma’am (Vaijutai) and Aniket for their thoughtful backend coordination, which made us feel genuinely valued. The surprise gift at the hotel and the parting souvenir were memorable gestures that we will cherish forever.

Overall, your team made this not just a trip for the two of us, but a joyful experience for our entire family who followed our journey from home. You don’t just “Cover the World”—you truly win hearts.

Thank you for giving us a lifetime memory. We wish your team continued success in creating such meaningful experiences for many more families. We look forward to planning all our future trips with you and will happily recommend you to our friends and family.

Warm regards,
Vijay & Priya Ghogare

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Complete Scam. Total Waste of Money!
​Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆
​If you are thinking about using Swayourway, do yourself a huge favor and close the tab right now. This company is a masterclass in how to alienate customers.
​Glitchy & Broken Platform: The entire service is completely unstable. Features that are heavily advertised either don't work at all or constantly crash mid-task. I spent hours trying to get things running smoothly, only to lose all my progress due to their buggy interface.
​Zero Accountability (Ghosted!): When the platform inevitably failed, I reached out for urgent technical support. Days went by without a single reply. They completely ghosted me after taking my payment. There is absolutely no post-purchase support.
​Impossible Refund Policy: When I realized the service was completely unusable, I requested a refund under their supposed "satisfaction guarantee." Of course, they pulled out obscure, hidden clauses from their terms and conditions to deny it.

​They are quick to charge your card, but non-existent when you actually need the service to work. It feels less like a legitimate business and more like a cash-grab. Avoid them like the plague!
